#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/bin/activate
cd /root/autodl-tmp/distrib_canary_collapse
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache

BASE_CMD="python -u iterative_train.py --model_name EleutherAI/pythia-410m --data_dir data/wikitext103_5k --num_generations 10 --steps_per_gen 5000 --batch_size 4 --max_length 512 --lr 5e-5 --gen_max_new_tokens 256 --gen_batch_size 16 --top_p 0.95 --optim adamw_torch"

run_exp() {
  local ALPHA=$1 SEED=$2 OUTDIR=$3
  echo "=== START: alpha=${ALPHA} seed=${SEED} $(date) ==="
  $BASE_CMD --synthetic_ratio ${ALPHA} --seed ${SEED} --output_dir ${OUTDIR}
  echo "=== DONE: alpha=${ALPHA} seed=${SEED} $(date) ==="
}

# α=0.45 remaining (s45 already running separately)
run_exp 0.45 46 results/phase_diagram/t10_a045_s46_fp32

run_exp 0.50 48 results/phase_diagram/t10_a050_s48_fp32

# α=0.55

run_exp 0.55 49 results/phase_diagram/t10_a055_s49_fp32

echo "=== ALL 14 EXPERIMENTS COMPLETE: $(date) ==="
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/autodl-tmp/distrib_canary_collapse/run_pd_batch_remaining.sh
